description: Texas delta. Speed limits from Transportation Code 545.352. Alcohol and GDL from the Texas Driver Handbook.

questions.q: Unless posted otherwise, the prima facie speed on a Texas street in an urban district is
questions.explanation: Transportation Code 545.352 sets 30 mph in an urban district on a street other than an alley, when no special hazard requires a slower speed.

questions.q: Unless a special hazard requires a slower speed, the lawful speed in a Texas alley is
questions.explanation: Texas Transportation Code 545.352: “15 miles per hour in an alley”.

questions.q: Outside an urban district, the lawful speed on a highway numbered by Texas or the United States is
questions.explanation: Texas Transportation Code 545.352: “70 miles per hour on a highway numbered by this state or the United States outside an urban district”.

questions.q: Outside an urban district, the lawful speed on a Texas highway that is not numbered by the state or the United States is
questions.explanation: Texas Transportation Code 545.352: “60 miles per hour on a highway that is outside an urban district and not a highway numbered by this state or the United States”.

questions.q: The lawful speed on a Texas beach is
questions.explanation: Texas Transportation Code 545.352: “on a beach, 15 miles per hour”.

questions.q: A Texas school bus is stopped on the highway to pick up a student and is operating its visual signal. A driver approaching from either direction
options: Must stop only if behind the bus
Shall stop before reaching the bus
May pass after sounding the horn
questions.explanation: Texas Transportation Code 545.066: “shall stop before reaching the school bus when the bus is operating a visual signal”.

questions.q: After stopping for a Texas school bus, you may proceed when the bus resumes motion, the visual signal is off, or
options: The bus driver signals you to proceed
No student is in your lane
A car behind you sounds its horn
questions.explanation: Texas Transportation Code 545.066: “the operator is signaled by the bus driver to proceed”.

questions.q: On a Texas highway with separate roadways, a driver is not required to stop for a school bus that is
questions.explanation: Texas Transportation Code 545.066: “for a school bus that is on a different roadway”.

questions.q: Unless on official business, a Texas driver may not follow a fire apparatus responding to a fire alarm closer than
questions.explanation: Texas Transportation Code 545.407: “may not follow closer than 500 feet a fire apparatus responding to a fire alarm”.

questions.q: Unless on official business, a Texas driver may not follow an ambulance that is flashing red lights closer than
questions.explanation: Texas Transportation Code 545.407: “follow closer than 500 feet an ambulance that is flashing red lights”.

questions.q: Before a right or left turn, a Texas driver must signal continuously for at least the last
questions.explanation: Texas Transportation Code 545.104: “shall signal continuously for not less than the last 100 feet of movement of the vehicle before the turn”.

questions.q: Under Texas law, a driver may not use the turn signals
options: As a "do pass" signal to a driver behind
When starting from a parked position
questions.explanation: Texas Transportation Code 545.104: “use the signals as a courtesy or "do pass" signal to the operator of another vehicle approaching from the rear”.

questions.q: When following another vehicle, Texas law requires a driver to keep
options: One car length in all conditions
An assured clear distance to stop safely
The same speed as the vehicle ahead
questions.explanation: Texas Transportation Code 545.062: “maintain an assured clear distance between the two vehicles”.

questions.q: A Texas driver commits an offense by using a portable wireless device to read, write, or send an electronic message while operating a motor vehicle, unless
questions.explanation: Texas Transportation Code 545.4251: “uses a portable wireless communication device to read, write, or send an electronic message while operating a motor vehicle unless the vehicle is stopped”.

questions.q: A Texas traffic signal is present but shows no indication in any signal head. An approaching driver
options: Must wait for a police officer
Shall stop, yield, and grant immediate use of the intersection
questions.explanation: Texas Transportation Code 545.151: “if a traffic-control signal is present but does not display an indication in any of the signal heads”.

questions.q: In Texas, a driver may not stand or park a vehicle within how many feet of a fire hydrant?
questions.explanation: Texas Transportation Code 545.302: “within 15 feet of a fire hydrant”.

questions.q: In Texas, a driver may not stand or park a vehicle within how many feet of a crosswalk at an intersection?
questions.explanation: Texas Transportation Code 545.302: “within 20 feet of a crosswalk at an intersection”.

questions.q: On the approach to a stop sign at the side of a Texas roadway, a driver may not stand or park within
questions.explanation: Texas Transportation Code 545.302: “within 30 feet on the approach to a flashing signal, stop sign, yield sign, or traffic-control signal located at the side of a roadway”.

questions.q: Under Texas law, which of these is a place where a driver may not stop, stand, or park?
questions.explanation: Texas Transportation Code 545.302: “An operator may not stop, stand, or park a vehicle: (1) on the roadway side of a vehicle stopped or parked at the edge or curb of a street; (2) on a sidewalk”.

questions.q: In Texas, what is the youngest age at which you can get a learner's permit for a car?
questions.explanation: Texas issues a learner's permit for a car at 15 years at the earliest.

questions.q: In Texas, how long must a driver under 18 hold a learner's permit before moving to the next license?
questions.explanation: Texas requires drivers under 18 to hold the learner's permit for 6 months.

questions.q: How many hours of supervised driving must a teen in Texas complete before getting a provisional license?
questions.explanation: Texas requires 30 hours of supervised driving before the provisional license.

provenance.manual: Texas Provisional License as a Teen | Department of Public Safety

questions.q: Of a Texas teen's required supervised driving hours, how many must be at night?
questions.explanation: Texas requires at least 10 hours of the supervised driving to be at night.

provenance.manual: Texas Provisional License as a Teen | Department of Public Safety

questions.q: In Texas, what is the youngest age at which a teen can get a license to drive without a supervisor?
questions.explanation: In Texas, the earliest unsupervised (provisional) license is at 16 years.

questions.q: During which hours may a newly licensed teen in Texas not drive without a supervisor?
questions.explanation: Texas restricts provisional drivers from Midnight to 5 a.m., with exceptions such as work or school.

provenance.manual: Graduated Driver License (GDL) and Hardship License | DPS

questions.q: In Texas, what is the youngest age for a full, unrestricted car license?
questions.explanation: Texas drivers can hold an unrestricted license at 18 years.

provenance.manual: Graduated Driver License (GDL) and Hardship License | Department of Public Safety

questions.q: What score do you need to pass the Texas car knowledge test?
questions.explanation: You need 70% to pass the Texas car knowledge test.

questions.q: In Texas, a driver 21 or older is legally impaired at what blood alcohol concentration?
questions.explanation: In Texas, drivers 21 and older are over the limit at 0.08% or more.

questions.q: In Texas, a driver under 21 breaks the law at what blood alcohol concentration?
questions.explanation: Texas sets the under-21 limit at 0.00%.

questions.q: In Texas, how long is the license suspension for an adult's first refusal of a breath or blood test?
questions.explanation: A first refusal in Texas brings a suspension of 180 days.

questions.q: How is Texas's seat belt law for adults enforced?
options: No seat belt law for adults
Primary: police can stop you just for not wearing a seat belt
Secondary: police can cite you only after stopping you for something else
questions.explanation: Texas seat belt enforcement is primary.

questions.q: Until what age must a child ride in a car seat or booster seat in Texas?
questions.explanation: Texas requires a car seat or booster until 8 years, with height or weight exceptions.

provenance.manual: Seat belt and car seat guidelines | TxDOT

questions.q: What is Texas's minimum liability insurance (injury per person / injury per crash / property damage)?
questions.explanation: Texas requires at least $30,000 / $60,000 / $25,000.
